request_json.message: What is the SOP for rooftop drone landings during a thunderstorm?

response_json.response:
According to warehouse protocol 'Pallet Stacking & Racking Regulations':
1. Stacking Limits: In Zone A (Heavy Goods / Building 1 High-Bay), pallets may be stacked up to a maximum of 3 tiers high. In Zone C (High Turnover / Building 2 Bulk), double stacking (maximum 2 tiers) is the absolute limit for safety.

rag_sources.title: Inventory quantities and stock question guide
rag_sources.content: Stock quantity definitions: On-hand is the recorded total quantity. Reserved is committed stock. Quarantined stock is unavailable for picking. Available stock excludes reserved and quarantined balances. Unassigned stock has a recorded balance but lacks a verified bin assignment. Use current inventory database results for quantities; this guide does not contain current product balances.
